**Log file**
For a crash or freeze, use F1 > Gameplay > Support > Open Log Folder and find
the latest `rerevved_NNN.log`. If the game cannot open, see
[file locations](https://github.com/ReRevvedRecomp/rerevved/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#file-locations).
Review the log with the
[log-sharing checklist](https://github.com/ReRevvedRecomp/rerevved/blob/main/docs/support.md#sharing-a-log)
before attaching a copy. Do not attach game files, saves, or your full data folder.
